title: chat: login fallback is identity
description: ChatContact display fallback goes login/displayName -> identity, not id. Update chat-server/chat-client docs and any code computing a display name (e.g. push senderDisplayName).
notes:
Regression-test attempt 1: no failing test possible. No code in the workspace computes a ChatContact display name or a push senderDisplayName (ChatMessageEntry/ChatMessagePush are only defined in crate-jmap-chat-types/src/push.rs; no producer). The only server-side fallback-adjacent behaviour, ChatContact/set create, already sets login = identity (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/contact.rs ChatContact::new(.., identity, identity, ..)). No doc in chat-types/server/client says 'fall back to id'. Fix is docs-only: optionally document the draft cefc217 fallback chain (displayName -> login -> identity) on ChatContact.login/display_name and ChatMessageEntry.sender_display_name.
Done in ae870470: docs only (rustdoc on ChatContact.login, display_name, ChatMessageEntry.sender_display_name). No regression test possible: nothing in the workspace computes a display name (verified by the 405z test-writer); server create already sets login = identity.
